name: subscript
description: Subscript - a multi-tenant subscription and revenue management platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @subscript/shared && concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev -w @subscript/web" "npm run dev -w @subscript/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @subscript/shared && npm run build -w @subscript/web && npm run build -w @subscript/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @subscript/shared && npm run typecheck -w @subscript/web && npm run typecheck -w @subscript/server && npm run typecheck -w @subscript/shared
scripts.test: npm run build -w @subscript/shared && npm run test -w @subscript/server && npm run test -w @subscript/web
